Hi Laura — great to connect earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we heard
- Orbit wants to validate integration approach for marketplace listing (SSO, billing connector, deployment model).
- Primary success criteria: streamlined onboarding for Orbit customers, clear SSO flow, and predictable latency targets for inference on marketplace SKUs.

Suggested next steps
1) Technical deep-dive (60m) with engineering: SSO, role mapping, listing manifest, and API contract.
2) Mutual action plan doc review (I attached the MAP draft).
3) Sync on timelines for marketplace certification.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 24 Feb: 9:30–10:30 or 13:00–14:00
- Thu 25 Feb: 11:00–12:00

If any of those work, we can lock calendar and share an invite with a short agenda. Camila will lead the engineering walkthrough from our side; Priyom will cover cert/marketplace ops.

Attachments: redwood_mtp_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (draft)
